tasks.text: GitHub hygiene: profile photo, bio (“Full-stack engineer (MERN/TS) building LLM systems”), pin your 3 best repos, add a README to each (problem · stack · run · screenshot). Unpin tutorial clones.
Set the 5-hour daily block in your real calendar for 6 days/week: DSA · main block · light block · career. Add Day 7 as review/rest.
